configuration.codeFlow.maxLogicBlocks.de: Maximum syntax-backed statement and expression blocks in a selected Function Logic flow.
configuration.includeExternalDependencie: Include external dependency nodes in graph views.
configuration.showUnresolvedEdges.descri: Show graph edges whose target cannot be resolved statically.

configuration.cache.maxSizeMb.descriptio: Maximum persisted analysis cache size in MiB.
